title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-31 current Weber author record: Volume I through section 46 and Volume III through section 100
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The page keeps broad working readers for Lehrbuch der Algebra while a source-checkable German/English repair stream replaces weaker translation drafts section by section.

Status at a glance. [#########-] broad draft available; source-checked repair stream now covers Volume I introduction through section 43, Volume II sections 176 through end matter, and Volume III sections 1-100 as paired German source and English translation readers. Volume-split top-level readers are used so readers can inspect the active coverage directly. Known clean-chain gaps remain Volume I sections 47-188 and Volume II sections 1-175. The next continuation points are Volume I section 47 and Volume III section 101.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, component PDFs, source-scan slices for checking, earlier section pairs, provenance notes, and source material for continued checking.
notes: Latest update supplies paired German/English high-fidelity readers through Volume I section 46 and Volume III section 100.
